categories.name: Knowledge & Understanding
criteria: Clear and focused topic or thesis
Strong understanding of the task and purpose
Writing consistently stays on topic

categories.name: Thinking
criteria: Logical and effective organization of ideas
Development of ideas using reasons, explanations, and relevant examples
Awareness of different perspectives

categories.name: Communication & Structure
criteria: Clarity, flow, and coherence of ideas
Effective paragraph structure
Clear introduction with a thesis or position
At least three body paragraphs
One main idea per body paragraph
Supporting details with explanation and examples
Inclusion of a counterpoint or alternate perspective
Clear conclusion that reinforces the thesis
Effective and varied transitions

categories.name: Application
criteria: Sentence variety and fluency
Grammar (consistent tense, agreement, complex sentences)
Punctuation (commas, quotation marks, apostrophes)
Spelling (grade-appropriate and subject-specific words)
Vocabulary use (precise and varied)

counterpointMissingPenalty.note: If the essay does not include an opposing viewpoint/counterpoint, subtract points even if structure is otherwise complete.

scoreMeaning.description: Well-organized and developed writing with clear reasoning and structure, meeting Grade 8 expectations
Clear structure and ideas with some weaknesses, appropriate for Grade 8
Structure present but underdeveloped or uneven; revision required at Grade 8 level
Major gaps in Grade 8 writing skills and organization

gradingPrinciples: Evaluate writing based on Grade 8 curriculum expectations only.
Do not apply secondary school (Grade 9+) writing standards.
Emphasize reasoning, organization, and clarity over length.
Apply spelling and language conventions according to the specified language variant.

softGuidelines: Use topics that encourage critical thinking and discussion.
Prompts should be answerable without formal research.
Encourage clear arguments supported by reasons and examples.
Allow exploration of different viewpoints while maintaining a clear position.
